title: Indian-Style Lentil Tacos
description: A flavorful twist on traditional tacos, featuring sautéed lentils and spices, served in a crispy taco shell.

ingredients.name: mild indian dhal
ingredients.notes: red or yellow lentils work well

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cumin, chili powder, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add dhal and dal. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in 2 cups water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Spoon lentil mixture into taco shells.
Top with shredded cheese, sour cream, and any desired toppings.
